content:
maya: kicking off terraform apply (dry-run first) for release/2026-03. Targets: vpc/natgw, iam roles. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. will do staging canary then prod.

deploybot: started terraform plan (workspace=prod, run=1865). plan output: 26 to add, 3 to change, 0 to destroy.

aj: hold on — we need to pin terraform & aws provider versions before apply. last time provider drift caused iam break.

aj: suggested pin:
```
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.7"
}
provider "aws" {
  version = "~> 4.70"
}
```

sophia: +1 to pin. Also set serial apply on natgw attach:
```
module "natgw" {
  count = var.az_count
  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = false }
}
```

maya: thanks. I'll push a tiny commit to lock versions and run a fresh plan (dry-run) against prod-canary first. tagging @aj @sophia for review.

deploybot: plan completed (run=1865). Summary:
- aws_iam_role.redwood-admin: 1 to update
- aws_vpc.redwood-main: 0 to change
- aws_nat_gateway.main: 2 to create

maya: plan looks good. proceeding with canary apply in prod-canary now.

deploybot: apply started (canary). Streaming logs:
```
Apply complete! Resources: 2 added, 1 changed.
```

sophia: verifying connectivity tests now. ping tests OK to internal services.

aj: noticed the iam role update includes a policy change to allow sts:AssumeRole from an external principal — that's expected, but we need to run the post-apply script to seed the new trust mapping. maya can you run:
```
./scripts/seed-trust-mapping --env=prod --role=redwood-admin
```

maya: running script... getting error: 403 from IAM API: 'Not authorized to perform iam:PutRolePolicy'. Hmm.

aj: are we using the right session keys? @deploybot run identity-check for the runner.

deploybot: identity-check: runner=infra-ci has permissions: iam:PassRole, iam:GetRole, iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy (false)

aj: looks like infra-ci cannot UpdateAssumeRolePolicy. This is why seed failed. we should not leave partial state. I'm going to trigger rollback for the canary.

maya: ack. what's rollback command?

aj: run:
```
git revert --no-edit HEAD
git push origin reverts/1865-iam-pin
terraform apply -target=aws_iam_role.redwood-admin -auto-approve
```

deploybot: cancelling ongoing apply (canary)...

deploybot: rollback apply started (run=1866).

deploybot: rollback completed. State reverted: aws_iam_role.redwood-admin restored to previous policy.

maya: manual check passed. connectivity unchanged. creating follow-up ticket for infra-ci perms.

sophia: adding action item: grant infra-ci iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy scoped to this role only, add guardrail in terraform.

maya: note for release notes: 'rolled back IAM trust update during canary due to missing infra-ci permission; will retry after privilege fix. No customer impact.'

aj: suggest adding preflight script to validate runner perms before apply. I'll draft it.

maya: filing postmortem ticket: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-2456 — assigning @aj @sophia. planning to reschedule prod apply in next change window.

oncall-bot: scheduled notification: next window 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. reminder in #eng-oncall 1h prior.

maya: thanks everyone. closing thread.
